notes.title: Development update (Bots, lobby system and more)
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.maroonersgame.com/promo/matchmake.gif?a[/img]

We're still hard at work on the big Marooners update. We've created about 20-30 new weapons and have a lot of work done on AI and lobby/connection improvements. Above is a preview of a lobby system overhaul, this should help address all issues and confusion when setting up any type of match.

To recap the contents of this update:
"Our main focus is the issue of when no other players are online to play with. By adding [b]AI[/b] and changing [b]game flow[/b](lobby) and possibly even [b]game mode setup[/b] we'll make sure you can always play and more people will stick around in online sessions. Last but not least, we'll also be adding some [b]extra content[/b]!"

Thanks for all your ongoing support, please keep spreading the word :)!
[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/WDR8Utd/]Join our Discord chat[/url] if you want to get the latest scoop about this update from the developers directly.

Edit: Just to clarify, this is not an April fools. This update is coming for real. Sorry for the bad timing!

Make sure to connect with us: [url=https://www.facebook.com/maroonersgame/]Facebook[/url] - [url=https://www.twitter.com/maroonersgame/]Twitter[/url] -



http://store.steampowered.com/app/423810/

notes.title: Marooners update announcement: AI, online players and more
notes.notes:
Hi Marooners!

Now that some time has passed since the official Steam launch we've taken the opportunity to evaluate what Marooners could improve upon best. Thanks to your feedback on the Steam forums we have a very clear picture of what we want to address.

Our main focus is the issue of when no other players are online to play with. By adding [b]AI[/b] and changing [b]game flow[/b](lobby) and possibly even [b]game mode setup[/b] we'll make sure you can always play and more people will stick around in online sessions. Last but not least, we'll also be adding some [b]extra content[/b]!

All of this will be released on Steam Q3 2017. Your feedback for this update is very welcome on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/423810/discussions]Steam forums[/url].

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Game update 1.02
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.maroonersgame.com/promo/fallingfloor.gif[/img]

The second update since launch has just landed!
We've addressed some feedback from the Steam forums and made some performance optimizations.

Thanks for all your ongoing support, please keep [url=https://www.youtube.com/results?sp=CAMSAggE&q=marooners]spreading the word[/url] :)!

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Seperated Gamepad and Keyboard control customization options
[*]Added keyboard/gamepad control reset option
[*]Fixed graphics looking pink/black on Shader Model 2.0 cards
[*]Updated controller support
[*]Fixed vsync saving correctly (Marooners no longer doubles as 1000 FPS room-heater)
[*]Upgraded Unity engine from 5.3 to 5.4.1 (Most important change: improved rendering performance)
[*]Performance improved: shaved off a few miliseconds on various scripts.
[/list]

If you encounter any issues, please use the F6 button in-game to report bugs. Have fun playing Marooners!

Make sure to follow us on social media: [url=https://www.facebook.com/maroonersgame/]Facebook[/url] - [url=https://www.twitter.com/maroonersgame/]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Post launch update
notes.notes:
Last week we officially launched Marooners and we're very happy with the results and support so far, thank you!

With the help of your feedback we've addressed the most important requests: You can now switch server regions to play with friends on a much faster connection. Furthermore various bugs have been fixed. Lastly we continue the free steam key offer, but have raised the unlock requirement to two hours for new players.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Added new server selections. Default is America (as before), but you can now manually switch to EU, Asia or Australia based servers under the multiplayer options
[*]The free steam key now unlocks after 2 hour of gameplay, however, all existing users only need to play 1 hour (although the in-game text will still mention 2 hours)
[*]Updated network library, improves network performance
[*]Fixed character not disappearing after player leaves
[*]Added AFK kick (only in-game if local player is inactive for 2 minutes)
[*]Better handling of disconnects mid-game
[*]Options split in Graphics, Sound, Controls, Multiplayer en Other sub menu's
[*]Fixed UI window bugs
[*]Fixed \n in texts
[*]Fixed UI Steam popup not disappearing
[*]Fixed getting stuck in arena lava level
[/list]

If there are any game breaking issues left, use the F6 button in-game to report bugs. Have fun playing Marooners!

Make sure to follow us on social media: [url=https://www.facebook.com/maroonersgame/]Facebook[/url] - [url=https://www.twitter.com/maroonersgame/]Twitter[/url]


http://store.steampowered.com/app/423810/

notes.title: Full release & events!
notes.notes:
[img]http://maroonersgame.com/promo/Cheer.gif[/img]

We're very happy to announce our full release on Steam today! We celebrate this launch with a 30% discount.

A big thank you to everyone who supported us during Early Access! You have all gotten the special "Wrench of Early Access" weapon which is now truly exclusive :).

Please spread the word & [url=https://twitter.com/MaroonersGame/status/776333890797592576]retweet[/url].

[h1]Launch events[/h1]

[b]Chat with devs[/b]
Celebrate the launch with us and other players, ask questions before buying or setup matches: https://discord.gg/6PtzJ8t

[b]Community: unlock new weapons together![/b]
The community can now work together to add 5 extra unlockable weapons to the game: 

Plump Plumber's Plunger: Exchange 333.333 slaps
Infinity Key of Destiny: Jump 250.000 times
Rolling Pin of Flattening: Trigger 555 secrets
Rake of Greener Grass: Steal 75.000 points
Whacking Racket: Send 2500 chatlines

See the progress of the global statistics in the game main menu.

[b]Earn a free Steam key to invite a friend[/b]
If you play one hour (real game-time) you unlock a free extra Steam key to gift to a friend! See the in-game main menu.

[b]Various[/b]
- 1 PM ET: BogOtter plays Marooners on Twitch (https://www.twitch.tv/bogotter)
- 17:00/5 PM CEST Reddit AMA on https://www.reddit.com/r/pcgaming/
 - The developers will be playing the game troughout the day

[h1]Future plans[/h1]
We will keep supporting the game, do let us know if you have any issues: use the F6 bugreport feature in-game or contact us on Discord/the Steam forums.

We are definitely checking out brining Marooners to other platforms and opening up cross-play to ensure an active online userbase.

As with all our products, Early Access has been invaluable because of the community, thank you for all feedback & help!

notes.title: Weekly update: Bonus games and ghosts!?
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.maroonersgame.com/promo/fallingfloor.gif[/img]

This week we've added a completely new bonus game: Devils drop. Choose a side, you'll be rewarded with treasure..or a very deep fall! We've also revised the ghosts implementation, making the game clearer and also more fun for death players. 

The game is currently 35% off in the steam summer sale, last weekend! http://www.maroonersgame.com

https://youtu.be/QIndtZX11xg

Changelog:
[list]
[*] New bonusgame, Devils drop! Choose a side, you'll be rewarded with treasure..or a very deep fall!
[*] Added a load of new SFX!
[*] Ghosts have been revised and are now working much better in all games
[*] High and Ultra graphics are now even fancier: fog and bloom settings correctly switch on/off
[*] Now up to three bonus games per session instead of max 1
[*] We did NOT add a secret "extreme" and "chaos" mode that can trigger when starting a match (OK, maybe we did)
[*] Better netsync & gameplay tweaks in Brimstone game
[*] Fixed the "100+ points in a minigame" achievement
[*] Bomb and boulder network sync
[*] Slow motion movement in brimstone&icy isles fixed
[*] Icy isles lighting improved
[*] Bomb throw distance shorter
[*] Fixed chatlines issues
[*] Lobby order fixed
[*] Rocky road treasure no longer under ground
[/list]

Next update in 7 days!

Make sure to follow us on social media: [url=https://www.facebook.com/maroonersgame/]Facebook[/url] - [url=https://www.twitter.com/maroonersgame/]Twitter[/url]


http://store.steampowered.com/app/423810/

notes.title: Post-PAX Update
notes.notes:
Last weekend we showed Marooners at PAX East (Boston) and this was a great success! Lots of players lined up for Marooners' first appearance.
This weeks update is focused on squashing a lot of bugs, see the video below for a quick recap:

https://youtu.be/MKrsR5F-YQc
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Friend joining improved
[*] Bomb no longer passes trough objects
[*] Continue music after main menu lobby.
[*] No more overlapping ready-music in lobby

notes.title: Weekly Update - New game: Icy isles!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.maroonersgame.com/promo/IcyIsles.gif[/img]

Todaywe've launched our second weekly update since Early Access and this is a big one: we've added a new game, improved the Mount Magma level design and more. Let us know what you think!

See the video below for a quick recap:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pbD0rAuXUdQ

Changelog:
[list]
[*] New game! Icy isles: Battle focussed. Push eachother into the ocean..but watch out for the wind! 
[*] Mount Magna: has been redesigned and now features cannons 
[*] At the start of every game: show title & simple instructions
[*] Updated clearer control image
[*] Optimizations (particles, memory, performance)
[*] Fixed getting stuck in the loading screen when another user disconnects
[*] Ghosts can now use jump pads
[*] Mines of Mayhem: No unbreakable rocks in first rows
[*] Controller support now via Unity instead of XInput(up to 6 controllers instead of 4)
[*] Lobby ready/unready now easier
[/list]


Enjoy the changes & cya next friday for another update!
Also make sure to follow us on social media: [url=https://www.facebook.com/maroonersgame/]Facebook[/url] - [url=https://www.twitter.com/maroonersgame/]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Weekly update: New character - Mauya!
notes.notes:
Exciting! This is the first update since our Early Access launch. See the development video below for a quick 38 seconds recap of this weeks work or check out the changelog below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?z=f&v=gJzzTcv_ro0

Changelog Friday April 1:
[list]
[*] Added a [b]new character[/b], the Inuit, Mauya!
[*] Keyboard player 1 now uses arrow keys, space bar and ctrl/alt
[*] Keyboard player 2 now uses numpad arrows and numpad-del, numpad-ins/numpad-enter
[*] Added Ghost particle FX
[*] Lava level ambient now correctly stops
[*] Fixed game not starting after quitting in-game
[*] Greatly improved performance by disabling games in background
[*] MOAR popups when errors occur
[*] Lobby arrows now clickable
[*] Make use of the best player ping available in online matches
[*] Hit distance nerfed
[*] Ghosts no longer drop coins
[*] Bomb explode time from 2.5 to 1.5 sec
[*] Tweaked idol times in Tag level

[*] Ghost tweak: immediately ghost
[/list]

[/list]

Enjoy the changes & cya next friday for another update!

notes.title: Weekly update: The first 24 hours on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.maroonersgame.com/promo/maroonyt.png[/img]

The last 24 hours we've been very busy working on the Marooners launch and immediately continued working on new improvements and content.

The game has only been available for a day and  we've already had a lot of fun watching people playing with friends. Hereby a selection of a few great laughs:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sjqAOuy3QAw]Maximum Coop [/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=snQo-o_DyLc]WhaTheGame[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eqsBaxyEv6Y]TheAlexDiablo[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PHWaESetNsY]BBtv[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PTzYiWXbnfo]Totalement Marteau[/url]

Keep the videos&streams coming :). Send us a message if you feature us, we'll make sure to watch&retweet!

[b]Update[/b]
Today we have launched a minor update which addresses a few bugs and improved steam friend joining (see [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/423810/discussions/0/392184522711029349/]this thread[/url] for instructions to play with friends).

Make sure to check back next Friday as we show you our first content update!

In the meanwhile, please support us on our Thunderclap for some extra promotion to fill up the game servers: help us reach as much people as possible in 7 days by contributing your follower counts!
